name: Marvel Rivals
native_kbm_note: Not confirmed. No source was found during this research (web search limit reached), and Wikipedia mentions only cross-play, not console keyboard/mouse. Believed to be controller-only on PS5; check this before relying on it.
notes: PC keys are sourced from magicgameworld (LMB primary, RMB secondary, R reload, V melee, E ability 1, LShift ability 2, F ability 3, Q ultimate, Z/X/C team-ups, Space jump/ascend, LCtrl descend, H change hero, Tab scoreboard). The PS5 buttons were NOT verified from a source; they come from general knowledge of the default controller layout and must be checked in-game. Ability 3 (F), descend (LCtrl) and team-ups (Z/X/C) were left out because their PS5 buttons could not be confirmed. Abilities differ per hero, but the slot bindings are shared.
